partners.mechanism_chain: GNAS (HGNC:4633) —DISRUPTS→ adenylate cyclase activity (GO:0004031); adenylate cyclase activity (GO:0004031) —DECREASES→ cAMP (CHEBI:17475); cAMP (CHEBI:17475) —LEADS_TO→ hearing impairment (HP:0000365); GNAS (HGNC:4633) —LEADS_TO→ hypocalcemia (HP:0003072); ADCY1 (HGNC:139) —DISRUPTS→ adenylate cyclase activity (GO:0004031). Mutations in GNAS can lead to loss-of-function (in the context of nonsyndromic hearing loss 44, potentially involving ADCY1 as well) or haploinsufficiency (in pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A). In both scenarios, GNAS dysfunction impairs adenylate cyclase activity, leading to reduced intracellular cAMP levels. The downstream consequences of this cAMP dysregulation manifest as distinct phenotypes: hearing impairment for nonsyndromic hearing loss 44 (potentially through ADCY1's role in cochlear function) and hypocalcemia for pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A (due to impaired PTH receptor signaling).
